mutations.before: where id = $1 and org_id = $2 and status = 'queued'
mutations.because: dropping 'and status = \'queued\'' from startQueuedJob allows an already running job to be claimed again, so duplicate delivery does not detect that the job has already been claimed (D171, D174d)
command: duplicate delivery: second startQueuedJob returns false and nothing runs twice
